Compiler flags (from the Makefile)

All versions:  -O3 -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra   (link: -lm)
OpenMP:        + -fopenmp
MPI:           built with mpicc (wraps the same gcc and flags)

Optional:      make clean && make ARCH=-march=native
               Tunes the code for the CPU of the machine that compiles (wider vector instructions).
               Only safe if the login node has the same CPU as the compute nodes; otherwise the
               program stops with "Illegal instruction". Comparing with and without it is a
               cheap optimization / sensitivity experiment.
